essence: Seeing birds, moths, or similar creatures forbids causing the prescribed ritual action.
The ritual may be performed in a seamless pavilion but never in the presence of others.
The lineage, its lord, its garland, and the union of lineage and non-lineage are all to be guarded.
Public exposure of the rites leads to failure of the work and even death or worse.
Because publicity brings death, the practice must never be revealed.
